description: Replaces the cards the track's sheet shows in the app with this list (call get_glance with forEditing: true first, and send the ones it has along with yours). A list shorter than the one it has is refused unless replace is true. Each card is {label, value, detail, group, tone, link, trend, set}; any of them can be a sheet formula starting with =, so the sheet works out the number and whether it's good, warn or bad. A card that turns warn or bad notifies the person. Formulas can't use IMPORT functions, IMAGE, HYPERLINK or WEBSERVICE.

cards.description: The whole list, 0 to 50 cards, in the order they show. An empty list removes them all.

detail.description: One line under it, like "left of $200".

group.description: Cards with the same group show together under it.

link.description: add (the sheet's form, answers after ?, like add?category=Dining), list?tab=Name (a form that adds a line to that tab, answers after &, like list?tab=Moves&from=Dining), todo, sheet, or sheet?tab=Name.

set.description: Optional. One cell with its tab, like Goals!B2, that the person can change from the card in the app (a goal, an amount per month, a balance): a typed cell the card's formulas read, never a formula.

tone.description: good, warn, bad or plain, or a formula giving one.

trend.description: Optional. The value over time, oldest first, drawn as a small line on the card: two or more numbers in one cell, usually a formula like =JOIN(" ", Weeks!B2:B13). Say what the points are in detail ("last 12 weeks").

value.description: The number, usually a formula, like =SUMIFS(Transactions!D:D, Transactions!C:C, "Dining").

replace.description: true when the person asked to remove some. Without it, a list shorter than the one the track has is refused, so nothing is dropped by mistake.

name: set_glance
title: Set a track's Glance cards
